authorization.scope: Recover the authorized ranking release after the first Pages build failed at the existing 1 MiB rankings snapshot bound. Remove only unused ranking snapshot fields, preserve validation compatibility for old snapshots, update disposable-fixture tests and the original release receipt, then merge through a CI-checked PR and verify Pages plus both public storefronts.

deploymentScope: public readback at dsh.store and dsh-store.cn

rootCause.symptom: The current generated ranking snapshot exceeded 1 MiB and the Pages job stopped before artifact upload/deployment.
rootCause.reproduction: The merged source and current public ranking snapshot reproduced a 1,050,413-byte snapshot, above the 1,048,576-byte limit.
rootCause.impact: No Pages artifact was uploaded or deployed; neither production storefront was changed by the failed run.

constraints: Omit only Catalog order and the legacy featured flag from newly built ranking snapshots; neither field participates in ranking or rendering.
Continue accepting valid optional order/featured fields in older public snapshots; do not change the snapshot schema version or ranking semantics.
Keep the existing 1 MiB bound unchanged in both builder and browser client; do not truncate candidate records or relax response limits.
Preserve exact official-tool top-ten placements, star logic, 30-row display cap, labels, listing status/reasons, admission, installability, and weekly stability.
Tests use disposable in-memory fixtures only; no writes to ~/.dsh, real profiles, Catalog, or DSH runtime.
gates: Verify base Commit ad74e3b9514c1ad4dabc2f00c7c62dacb0ae6391 and all file-scope SHA-256 preconditions.
Focused tests cover compact new snapshots, legacy snapshot compatibility, ranking placement and unchanged admission boundaries.
Run npm run check and git diff --check.
Build the full marketplace from the current Catalog/candidate data and current public ranking snapshot; require generated rankings/data.json <= 1 MiB without weakening the bound.
Create an auditable PR; require all checks on the exact PR head to pass before merge.

After merge, verify Pages deployment succeeded for the merge SHA, then read both https://dsh.store/rankings/ and https://dsh-store.cn/rankings/ and confirm both charts contain both official tools in distinct randomized top-ten positions.

rollback.method: Revert only this recovery PR through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.production: If the recovered deployment fails public acceptance, revert through a checked PR, allow Pages to deploy the reverted build, and verify both domains. Do not alter Catalog state or ranking snapshot history.

verification.recoveryBuild: Static marketplace build completed from current local repository data and prior public snapshot without GitHub enrichment; registry entries=798; output is a local disposable build only.
